The '''Solarix-G6''' was a model of podracer during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Podracer [[Kidd Kareen]] used a black Solarix.

==History==
Kidd Kareen had been using this model pod since before he signed to race the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Speedway]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Kareen used this pod to push [[Poorfo]]'s [[XR-Dualmega]] into a wall during a qualifying lap. During the race, Kareen used his pod to block his teammate [[San Maxus]]' attempts to kill Kareen's new friend [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been tracking Maxus down because as he had been using the podracing circuit as a cover to spy for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When Tano's podracer was destroyed, Kareen caught her with his pod and delivered her to safety.
